import asyncio
import os
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
from chupa.git import Git
from chupa.seams import SubprocessExec
from chupa.specs import entry_unit_gap, resolve_plan_contract, PlanContractError
async def main():
    root = Path.cwd()
    git = Git(SubprocessExec(), env=dict(os.environ), timeout=30)
    head = await git.rev_parse(root, 'HEAD')
    print('Base HEAD:', head)
    print('Worktree status:', repr(await git.status_porcelain(root)))
    plan = await git._run(root, 'show', f'{head}:CHUPA_PLAN.md')
    registry = yaml.safe_load(plan.split('# BEGIN_REGISTRY_P3\\n', 1)[1].split('# END_REGISTRY_P3', 1)[0])
    print('admissions[7]:', registry['admissions'][7])
    for stem in registry['admissions'][7]:
        uid = f'19.P3.{stem}'
        print(entry_unit_gap(plan, stem))
        try:
            resolve_plan_contract(plan, [uid])
        except PlanContractError as exc:
            print(str(exc))
    print('Registry lines:')
    for n, line in enumerate(plan.splitlines(), 1):
        if line.startswith('  background-consumers:') or line.startswith('  control-inbox:'):
            print(n, line)
asyncio.run(main())
